title: Cheap to burn, costly to bear: What fuels Indonesia’s persistent cycle of fires and haze?
summary: Wildfires in Indonesia have caused transboundary haze and disrupted livelihoods in Sumatra. In the last of a three-part series, CNA looks at why the fires persist despite bans and crackdowns - and what it will take to stamp them out for good.
